newsitem.title: GERMANY: Germany's Pro7 declines comment on Nickelodeon.
newsitem.headline: Germany's Pro7 declines comment on Nickelodeon.

text.p: German television group ProSieben Media AG on Monday declined to comment on a newspaper report that it was in talks to take over the German subsidiary of Nickelodeon, the U.S. children's TV channel.
Nickelodeon has produced the only serious contender to challenge an increasingly popular children's programme produced by the public broadcasters ARD and ZDF called "Kinderkanal".

The weekly Welt am Sonntag newspaper reported that ProSieben and Viacom, which holds 90 percent of German Nickelodeon, were in talks aimed at having ProSieben acquire a majority in the children's channel.
"We will not comment on this," a ProSieben spokesman told Reuters.
The newspaper report added that Viacom and ProSieben would sign an agreement on Nickelodeon in the next few days.
Film and TV production group Ravensburger Film + TV GmbH holds 10 percent of Nickelodeon. The newspaper report said Ravensburger wants to sell its stake in the company.
